info.title: GetProducts
info.description: Use this API to get detailed information of the specified products.

get.description: Use this API to get detailed information of the specified products.

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: app_key
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: Unique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: timestamp
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: sign_method
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: sign
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: Part of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click here for details)

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: filter
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Returns the products with the status matching this parameter. Possible values are all, live, inactive, deleted, pending, rejected, sold-out. Mandatory.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: update_before
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned product list to those updated before or on a specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Optional

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: create_before
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned products to those created before or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Optional

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: offset
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Deprecated(The number of Items you want to skip before you start counting),It is recommended to use date for scrolling query.The maximum offset is 10000

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: create_after
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned products to those created after or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Optional

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: update_after
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned products to those updated after or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Optional

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: limit
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: The number of Items you would like to fetch from every response,The maximum is 50.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: options
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: This value can be used to get more stock information. e.g., Options=1 means contain ReservedStock, RtsStock, PendingStock, RealTimeStock, FulfillmentBySellable.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: sku_seller_list
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Only products that have the Seller SKU in this list will be returned. Input should be a JSON array. For example, ["Apple 6S Gold", "Apple 6S Black"]. It only matches the whole words. A maximum of 100 SKUs can be returned.

client = LazopApiClient::Client.new(url, appkey, appSecret)
request = LazopApiClient::Request.new('/products/get','GET')
request.add_api_parameter("filter", "live")
request.add_api_parameter("update_before", "2018-01-01T00:00:00+0800")
request.add_api_parameter("create_before", "2018-01-01T00:00:00+0800")
request.add_api_parameter("offset", "0")
request.add_api_parameter("create_after", "2010-01-01T00:00:00+0800")
request.add_api_parameter("update_after", "2010-01-01T00:00:00+0800")
request.add_api_parameter("limit", "10")
request.add_api_parameter("options", "1")
request.add_api_parameter("sku_seller_list", " [\"39817:01:01\", \"Apple 6S Black\"]")
response = client.execute(request, accessToken)
puts response.success?
puts response.body
